source: SRC-APH-REOPEN-2024-27; APH 2024-27 Chapter II §2.3.3(d-e), Table 2.1, printed pp. 13-14 (PDF pp. 27-29).
verified_requirements: Institution representation for wrongly submitted application must include its Trust/Society/Company resolution (or the specified government-institution authorization), in Format 3.
Representation must be within the final date notified for the approval process.
Application may be reopened one time, with Competent Authority approval.
Institution must pay necessary TER charges and applicable late-submission penalty before it resumes the application.
enforced_by_application: single persisted reopening request per application
reopening request supported by a same-case resolution document
Competent Authority must reference the applicable public notice when confirming the filing window
institution payment evidence must be reviewed by a Competent Authority before the application transitions back to returned for correction

yearly_inputs.note: The applicable annual notice, category/institution-specific TER amount and late-penalty calculation are not computed by this prototype. The reviewer must inspect source-backed payment evidence; do not treat a missing schedule as zero or waive payment.

prototype_scope.note: The current workflow supports reopening after final submission and before scrutiny begins. Other in-process states require route-specific verification before being added.
